integrity: Exact all-n analytic proof including local uniqueness and two-step Floquet minimax; checker supplies nonexhaustive numerical corroboration only. No independent scientific validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The two-cycle is locally attracting only after quotienting common-phase symmetry, and only for even unweighted rings in the specified open interval. The neutral stability at h=pi/4 is not resolved nonlinearly, global basins and other cycles are not classified, and prior-art search is not exhaustive.
title: A sharp period-doubling branch and optimally damped transverse modes in even Huygens rings
